hypothesis: Original upstream PyTorch Community-1 segmentation/embedding/VBx path can retain global identities and simultaneous speech that the converted CoreML path lost. Distinct provider/runtime, not threshold or speaker-count tuning.

candidate.parameters: Unmodified pinned config.yaml defaults: VBx threshold.6/Fa.07/Fb.8; min_duration_off0; batch32; overlap-excluded embedding; default automatic count; CPU2. No num/min/max speaker hints.
candidate.rawObservation: Complete native model forward output matrices, segmentation/count/embedding/discrete native hooks and centroid bytes plus unmodified regular/exclusive annotations. Only regular annotation used for overlap scoring.
candidate.support: PCM frame count and hash before imports; native final turns must lie in exact physical PCM support. Full native operands saved before support admission; no clipping/rewrite of endpoints or local-slot concatenation.

advance: One independent native call per case; score complete admitted raw result; next case only after every prior gate passes. Any quality/support/resource failure stops; no retuning/count truth. All short pass before preregistering long BSP336/four600.

execution.repairAllowance: One infrastructure-only repair with new identity; failed native attempts retained. No quality recipe repairs.

runtime.precedence: Explicit prepend of frozen new layer; immutable donor ordinary startup preserved. No donor mutation.

limitations: Same reused development/confirmation fixtures; not untouched or training-held-out.
Model benchmark/training overlap not independently excluded.
No known-person identification or word attribution claim.
Optional research donor/layer is not a consumer installation or sealed relocated runtime.
Process RSS excludes separate system/accelerator services; CPU execution selected.
Single native run per input; resource differences not speedup claims.
